FLOPPY BRICK BREAKER / FIRST LIGHT HUMAN ALPHA

Floppy game concept and human-versus-bot challenge idea by Corben;
developed together by Corben and Marc, with their agents.

Human play is a separate, unranked one-board alpha. Assisted director and direct
cart-force controls are separate input modes. The passive hinge has no motor.
This does not change Corben-versus-Marc autonomous controller competition.

Browser profile: floppy-first-light-human-mujoco-3.8.0-v1
Runtime: official @mujoco/mujoco 3.8.0 WebAssembly
Original contact rules revision: 2
Selected source revision: 74bde0779fc9bc6b569ffd10e07b0db18de6ad85
Board: First Light, 15 one-health bricks, 100 points per removed brick
Human mode: seed 20261019; three lives; 120 simulated seconds; no timeout win
Force delivery: Float32, clamped to +/-80 N, held for 20 ms

The official MuJoCo WebAssembly and a JavaScript loader with the documented
upstream Emscripten static Embind patch are bundled locally. The patch and
Emscripten copyright/license are retained in engine/vendor/.
MuJoCo is developed by Google DeepMind and its contributors and licensed under
Apache 2.0. Its license is included at ./engine/vendor/LICENSE.
Upstream: https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mujoco/mujoco/v/3.8.0

PUBLICATION SCOPE

This is a deliberately selected joint Arena release, with the origin credit
carried into the title, controls, recording and documentation. It publishes
selected model/rules and replay geometry/statistics, not the research workspace
or its raw archives and correspondence. It makes no license assertion for the
rest of that workspace. The website code follows the repository license;
bundled MuJoCo retains its Apache 2.0 license.

Full public source and release notes:
https://github.com/marctheshark3/pendulum-arena/blob/main/docs/floppy.md

Selected product validation: /floppy/validation.json
